title: Jihee Yoon
text:
Real World
  Why segmentation matters
  
    
      
        
          
            
            Every market has heterogeneous customers — different needs, different willingness to pay, different behavior patterns.
          
          
            
            A single product or message aimed at the "average" customer ends up resonating with nobody — you leave value on the table.
          
          
            
            Segmentation lets you allocate resources where they have the highest return — high-LTV segments get retention spend, price-sensitive segments get promotions.
          
        
      

      
        A good segmentation is
        
          Relevant
          Identifiable
          Actionable
          Substantial
          Accessible
        
      
    

    
      
        🎬
        
          Netflix
          Segments users by watch behavior — binge watchers, casual viewers, movie lovers — to personalize thumbnails and recommendations per profile.
          ↑ Reduces churn by keeping each segment engaged differently
        
      
      
        🚗
        
          Uber
          Identifies rider archetypes from trip frequency, timing, and spend — then sends targeted promos: discounts to casuals, subscriptions to commuters.
          ↑ Today's example — let's see how K-means builds these segments

title: Jihee Yoon
text:
Segmentation at Uber
  Example: What do Uber's segments look like?
  Clusters are just math — profiling gives them meaning the business can act on
  

    
      Cluster A
      🚗
      Weekend Riders
      
        Trips / month3–4
        Peak timeFri–Sat night
        Price sensitivityHigh
        Eats usageRare
        LTVLow–Medium
      
      
        
        Activate with discount codes
      
    

    
      Cluster B
      💼
      Daily Commuters
      
        Trips / month20–22
        Peak timeMon–Fri 8am/6pm
        Price sensitivityLow
        Eats usageModerate
        LTVHigh
      
      
        
        Lock in with Uber One subscription
      
    

    
      Cluster C
      🍔
      Eats Power Users
      
        Orders / month16–20
        Peak timeLunch & dinner daily
        Price sensitivityMedium
        Rides usageOccasional
        LTVVery High
      
      
        
        Reward & retain with loyalty perks

title: Jihee Yoon
text:
K-Means Algorithm
    Clusteringin 4 steps
    
      
        1
        Place centroidsPick K random starting points
      
      
        2
        Assign pointsEach point → nearest centroid
      
      
        3
        Move centroidsRecompute cluster means
      
      
        4
        RepeatUntil assignments stabilize
      
    
  
  
    
    
      Next Step ▶
      Reset

title: Jihee Yoon
text:
Segmentation → Action
  Different segments, different strategies
  Segmentation is only valuable when it changes decisions.
  

    
      CLUSTER A · WEEKEND RIDERS
      Activate with discounts
      
      
        →$5 off Friday night push notification
        →Referral bonus to grow the casual base
        →Retarget on Instagram / TikTok
      
    

    
      CLUSTER B · DAILY COMMUTERS
      Lock in with subscriptions
      
      
        →Uber One free trial targeting
        →Reserved rides for predictable routes
        →Priority pickup as loyalty perk
      
    

    
      CLUSTER C · EATS POWER USERS
      Reward and retain
      
      
        →Free delivery on 10th order
        →Exclusive restaurant early access
        →Upsell to rides via in-app cross-promo

title: Jihee Yoon
text:
K-Medoids (PAM)
    A more robustalternative
    
      Unlike K-Means, the center must be a real data point — not an average. More robust to outliers.
    
    
      
        1
        Pick medoidsChoose K actual data points as centers
      
      
        2
        Assign pointsEach point → nearest medoid
      
      
        3
        Swap medoidsTry each non-medoid as a replacement; keep if cost decreases
      
      
        4
        RepeatUntil no swap improves the solution
      
    
  
  
    
    
      Next Step ▶
      Reset
